channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: After Russian Diesel Deal, Trump Faces New Crisis Over Ukraine
item.description: President Trump’s surprise decision to suspend sanctions on Russian diesel fuel stunned Ukrainian and European officials, who were meeting with U.S. envoys at an exclusive golf club near Miami.

item.title: NPR: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home, DOJ says it approved the warrant
item.description: The Justice Department says the search is part of an "ongoing federal investigation", while Omar calls it "an attempt to target political enemies"

item.title: BBC News: Burnham to push for new post-Brexit deals at EU summit
item.description: Conservative leader Kemi Badenoch said the prime minister was "unpicking" the deal the UK signed with the EU.

item.description: Vatican expects a one-week hospital recovery for the 71-year-old Catholic leader ahead of scheduled Latin America tour.

item.title: Ars Technica: Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine
item.description: Russian bloggers warn Russia’s hyper-centralized digital economy is vulnerable.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: Kevin Roose Didn’t Use AI to Write His Book About AI
item.description: The author of The AGI Chronicles says his book “was written by a very tired, overworked, under-slept human being.”

item.title: WIRED Science: They War-Gamed Dimming the Sun. It Went Even Worse Than You Think
item.description: Solar geoengineering could buy humanity time against climate change—or trigger a dangerous new arms race. A first-of-its-kind simulation offered a glimpse of what happens when geopolitics takes the wheel.

item.title: WIRED Business: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
item.description: Meta’s biggest model rivals the world’s best—and includes new features to keep agents from going off the rails.
